name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.214
notes: Lock UI is now exclusive: either the first-time setup card OR the unlock grid — never both (fixes the hybrid welcome+grid screen).
When not configured, any leftover keyboard HTML is cleared so old keys cannot be tapped.
Save Combination writes keys + CL_SEC_PROFILE_V1 + settings.securityProfile and read-back verifies letter/color stuck.
Lock screen shows build version (e.g. v9.10.347.214) so we can confirm the device is running this build, not a cached older one.
label: SecureAccessExclusiveLockUI
summary: Exclusive lock UI + verified multi-target save + visible build on lock screen.
fixes: Lock screen shows CURRENT_VERSION for cache diagnosis.
testing: After install: lock screen must show v9.10.347.214 in the Secure Access tagline.
Save Combination with M + Purple + question + answer → success message includes Letter M · purple.
Lock: grid only (no welcome card). Tap M only → Tap 1 of 4, stays locked.
If lock shows welcome only: combination was not saved — open Settings Secure Access and Save Combination again.
